description: Map of Slack functions the workflow engine can use. The AI/converger reads the AVAILABLE subset (implemented AND the client's token grants requiredScopes) so it only proposes actions that genuinely work. To add a capability: add an entry here, implement its handler in index.js, and flip `implemented` to true. Actions not listed are not proposable.

actions.label: Post a message to a channel
actions.description: Post a message to a public or private channel the bot can access.

config.hint: Message text; omit to use the prior step output
Override the bot display name (requires chat:write.customize)
Override the bot icon emoji e.g. :robot_face: (requires chat:write.customize)

actions.label: Send a direct message to a user
actions.description: Open a DM with a user (by Slack user ID or email) and send them a message.

config.hint: Slack user ID (U…) or email address
Message text; omit to use the prior step output

actions.label: Reply in a thread
actions.description: Post a threaded reply under an existing message.

config.hint: ts of the parent message to reply under
Reply text; omit to use the prior step output

actions.label: Add an emoji reaction to a message
actions.description: React to a message with an emoji.

config.hint: ts of the message to react to
Emoji name without colons, e.g. white_check_mark

actions.label: Upload a file or snippet to a channel
actions.description: Upload text content or a file to one or more channels.

config.hint: File text content or prior step output

actions.label: Create a Slack channel
actions.description: Create a new public or private channel.

config.hint: true to create a private channel

actions.label: Invite a user to a channel
actions.description: Invite one or more users to a channel.

config.hint: Comma-separated Slack user IDs to invite

actions.label: Set a channel topic
actions.description: Update the topic of a channel.

actions.label: Pin a message in a channel
actions.description: Pin an existing message to a channel.

config.hint: ts of the message to pin

actions.label: Set a reminder for a user
actions.description: Create a reminder for a user. Requires a user OAuth token — not available with a bot token. Will be enabled when per-user OAuth is added.

config.hint: When to send — unix timestamp or natural language e.g. 'in 30 minutes'
Slack user ID to remind (omit for the bot itself)

actions.label: Look up a user by email
actions.description: Resolve a Slack user ID from an email address. Uses users.list scan (more reliable than users.lookupByEmail which has undocumented Slack API restrictions).

actions.label: Search messages in Slack
actions.description: Search across messages and return matching results. Requires a user OAuth token — not available with a bot token. Will be enabled when per-user OAuth is added.

config.hint: Search query, supports Slack modifiers e.g. in:#channel from:@user

actions.label: Read recent messages from a channel
actions.description: Fetch the most recent messages from any channel type: public (channels:history), private (groups:history), DMs (im:history), or group DMs (mpim:history).

config.hint: Number of messages to fetch (default 20, max 100)
Fetch messages after this unix timestamp

actions.label: List channels in the workspace
actions.description: Returns all channels (public and private) with their IDs and names. The AI uses this to discover valid channel targets before posting. Requires channels:read for public; groups:read for private.

actions.label: List workspace members
actions.description: Returns workspace members with IDs, names, and emails. The AI uses this to discover user IDs for DMs or lookups.

actions.label: Join a channel
actions.description: Have the bot join a public channel (useful before posting without chat:write.public).

actions.label: Leave a channel
actions.description: Remove the bot from a channel.

actions.label: Remove an emoji reaction from a message
actions.description: Remove a previously added emoji reaction.

actions.label: Get reactions on a message
actions.description: Read all emoji reactions on a specific message (useful for trigger/condition logic).

actions.label: List pinned items in a channel
actions.description: Get all pinned messages and files in a channel.

actions.label: Get a user's detailed profile
actions.description: Fetch full profile: title, phone, avatar, email, custom fields.

actions.label: List user groups
actions.description: Get all user groups (teams) in the workspace with their IDs and handles.

actions.label: Get workspace info
actions.description: Get the workspace name, domain, and ID.

actions.label: List files in the workspace or a channel
actions.description: Browse files shared in the workspace, optionally filtered to a channel.

actions.label: Check a user's Do Not Disturb status
actions.description: Check whether a user's DND is active — useful before sending a DM.

actions.label: List custom emoji
actions.description: Get all custom emoji names in the workspace (useful for picking valid reaction names).

actions.label: Create or update a user group
actions.description: Create a new user group or update its members. Useful for managing teams.

config.hint: Comma-separated user IDs to set as members

actions.label: List channel bookmarks
actions.description: Get all bookmarks in a channel.

actions.label: Add a bookmark to a channel
actions.description: Add a URL bookmark to a channel's bookmarks bar.

actions.label: Read a Slack canvas
actions.description: Read the content of a Slack canvas document.

actions.label: Create or update a Slack canvas
actions.description: Create a new canvas or update an existing one.

actions.label: Search files in Slack
actions.description: Search files across the workspace. Requires a user OAuth token — not available with a bot token alone.

actions.label: Search private/DM content
actions.description: Search messages in private channels, DMs, and group DMs. Requires a user OAuth token — not available with a bot token alone.

actions.label: Send a group direct message
actions.description: Open a multi-person DM (MPIM) and send a message.

config.hint: Message text; omit to use the prior step output
